description:
Join the Push Pin Travel Maps Affiliate Program and partner with a trusted brand loved by over 250,000 travelers! We specialize in handcrafted, high-quality travel maps that help people track their adventures in style.

With free personalization, multiple frame options, and numerous personalization opportunities, our maps make unforgettable gifts for travel lovers. Affiliates earn a competitive 10% commission on every sale, with an average order value of $200+, meaning your earnings can add up fast. Payments are made reliably each month. Whether you're a travel blogger, gift guide curator, or content creator, this is a great way to monetize your audience with a product they’ll love.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Push Pin Travel Maps! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and as an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to purchase products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, you agree to use the Program in the manner specified below and are bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY affiliate program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for rejecting your application.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Affiliate links are automatically generated, and you may also generate links for specific products or collections. If a customer clicks on multiple referral links, the last-clicked affiliate link will receive credit.

You may or may not be assigned a coupon code. If assigned, usage details will be clarified in your affiliate dashboard. When both an affiliate link and a coupon code are used in a single transaction, only one commission will be credited. If you are not assigned a branded coupon, you are not authorized to promote any coupon.

Affiliates may promote the merchant's website across online platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, blogs, and other approved channels. Offline promotion through magazines or classified ads is also permitted.

3. Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn commissions on qualifying purchases made through their unique affiliate links. Commission rates are based on the order subtotal and do not include taxes, shipping, or other fees.

In order to receive commissions, you must enter valid payment details in your settings. The payment schedule will be outlined on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments are issued only for completed transactions. We reserve the right to review every referral to ensure compliance. Chargebacks and refunded transactions are not eligible for commissions.

4. Marketing Tools

We provide approved promotional materials, including banners, logos, and specific campaign creatives. These can be accessed under the 'Marketing Tools' section of your dashboard for use on your affiliate channels.

5. Network Program

If the network feature is activated, you may invite other affiliates to join as your downline. You will earn a network commission based on their qualifying sales, in accordance with our merchant settings.

Use your unique network link to refer new affiliates.

6. Cookies & Tracking

We use cookies to track referral traffic. If a customer disables or clears their cookies, we may not be able to track their activity and therefore cannot award commissions for that session.

The cookie duration is specified during the affiliate registration. All purchases made within the cookie window will be attributed to the affiliate whose link or coupon was used.

7. Coupon Code-Only Websites

We do not accept or approve affiliate applications from websites whose primary purpose is to promote or distribute coupon codes. This includes websites that solely feature deals, discounts, or promotional codes without offering genuine content, reviews, or added value.

We are committed to partnering with affiliates who offer original content, product recommendations, or other forms of authentic engagement with their audiences. Applications from coupon-only sites will be denied, and existing affiliates found violating this policy may be removed from the program.

8. Removal from the Affiliate Program

Affiliates may request removal from the program by contacting us at info@pushpintravelmaps.com.

Thank you for being part of our Affiliate Program!

We’re excited to work with you. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at info@pushpintravelmaps.com. These terms may be revisited and updated at any time, so please check back periodically.
